[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] Lack of Solar Track Record: Because they only pivoted to solar in April 2026, there is very little long-term history regarding the quality of their solar installations or how they handle warranty claims down the track. In the Australian solar industry, companies closing down and leaving customers without warranty support ("orphan solar") is a common issue.
Budget Business Model: Based on consumer discussions, they target the extreme budget end of the market. Buyers have noted that while their advertised prices are incredibly cheap, this pricing assumes a "perfect" standard installation. You may face extra charges for things like two-story homes, larger 10kW inverters (which many solar enthusiasts highly recommend over the standard 5kW), or three-phase power upgrades.
Name Confusion: Be careful when looking up reviews. There is a completely separate, older company called "Solar Battery Group" which has thousands of reviews online. Solar Battery & Solar Panel Group is intentionally or unintentionally using a very similar name, which makes it harder to find reviews for this specific Guildford-based company
